description: Seen on fz-sc8.62: Kernel.+/2 ends in 'def _left + _right, do: arithmetic_error()', which accepts every pair, yet the plan for the +[any, any] activation still carries a fail node after it (visible in the quicksort stats and the static-reach census taken for .62). Nothing can reach that node. Dispatch planning (src/compiler2/dispatch.rs, dispatch_reachability.rs) should see that a clause whose head is total for the keyed row ends the plan, and build no arm of last resort behind it. Pin with a plan-shape test; expect the native function count and census of affected fixtures to fall, never rise.
title: A dispatch plan builds no fail node after a clause that accepts every row
